title: slipstream.capture.stopped.v1
$comment: The final record of an activation that stopped cleanly: observation stopped, accepted work drained, then this record was made durable before the log closed. It is never written after a lost lock or an unwritable store, so a missing stop together with no live owner heartbeat means not confirmed live, never still recording. detached: an explicit detach. archived: the workspace was archived. maintenance: stopped for garbage collection; capture resumes later on the same session. root-missing: the watched root was deleted or replaced. watcher-failed: the watcher subscription closed or could not be kept. The reason set is closed for v1. Self-contained; unknown fields permitted for forward compatibility.
